citation: Porter, Verbiscer and Canup (2025), Shapes, Masses, and Densities of the Small Satellites of Pluto, presentation slide 7
orientation: Non-synchronous flyby rotation approximation; prime meridian is a display convention. The 2025 fit has no converged pole solution. No body-fixed cartographic registration is claimed.
qualification: Approximate single-triaxial 2025 fit to two resolved LORRI epochs and approach photometry. The source also permits a contact-binary interpretation; no unique detailed mesh or surface map is claimed. Older 19 × 10 × 9 km dimensions are not used.
